selector.name: CONSERVATIVE_ONE_SWAP_V1
selector.purpose: Combine the frozen V2A model ticket with independently recorded Stalltips while preserving ticket row structure.

frozenRules: Start from the frozen MAX_P7 V2A ticket.
CONSENSUS selections are protected and cannot be removed.
For a non-banker leg, at most one STALLTIPS_ONLY horse may replace one MODEL_ONLY horse.
The incoming STALLTIPS_ONLY horse is the one with the highest V2A probability.
The outgoing MODEL_ONLY horse is the one with the lowest V2A probability.
A k=1 model banker is never automatically replaced.
If Stalltips disagrees with a model banker, the disagreement is flagged for review only.
The number of selections per leg is preserved.
The total row count and ticket cost are preserved.
No hybrid P7 probability is reported without calibrated Stalltips per-horse probabilities.
notes: Stalltips must be captured before the first relevant race starts.
Synthetic fixtures are contract tests only and are not performance evidence.
V2A remains the frozen horse-model champion.
Hybrid Selector v1 is a challenger policy pending prospective evidence.
